experiment: A1-M source support, target sampling and full-map sensitivity
gauge: Original prefix position gauge only. Do not multiply all gauge x density x pattern combinations.

full_mixed.office2_full: All 1545979 native-active candidates including prefix. Replace local only where original source GT interior exists. Others retain effective predicted local. Change rigid placement of all candidates.
full_mixed.HKairport01_full_common: All 3242219 native-active candidates including prefix. Replace local on all-camera-intersection source LiDAR only (previously 7609 candidates). Others predicted.
full_mixed.HKairport01_full_wide: Same full native map; replace local on sequence-camera valid source LiDAR only (previously 261958 candidates). Others predicted. C00/C01 must equal full_common byte-for-byte.

sparsification.uniform_hash: SplitMix64(pixel linear index XOR SplitMix64(frame ID XOR seed)); top 53 bits / 2^53 < density. No depth, confidence or error argument; densities nested.
sparsification.scan_rows: period=round(1/density); phase=SplitMix64(frame ID XOR seed) mod period; retain v mod period == phase. Same phase hash gives nested 1%/10% row sets. Report actual density after GT/native validity; no quota refill.
sparsification.source_only: Select same stored candidate rows from all four original C maps by registered source pixel mask. Preserve exact surviving centers, covariance, RGB/opacity and original scale. Evaluate dense target GT; no footprint/opacity inflation, no hole filling.
sparsification.target_only: Reuse unchanged dense C maps and cached renders. Restrict reference-valid target pixels by the independently frame-indexed pattern; no new rendering or Gaussian changes. Report sampled-GT fraction AND fraction of all dense GT. This simulates missing measurements, not sensor noise or true LiDAR acquisition.

evaluation.views: All original 400 office2 / 40 HK views. Keep tracking-gap strata.
evaluation.primary: Each scope common4; paired common8 for dense-vs-each-source-thinning, strict/wide/full-mixed scope pairs. No 16-arm universal intersection.
evaluation.target_only_denominator: Coverage/correct coverage conditional on sampled GT plus separate full-GT measurement fraction. Dense GT is unchanged and retained as the full-map reference; no claimed reconstruction improvement from hiding targets.
evaluation.source_only_denominator: Original dense reference-valid target pixels unchanged; use dense support gate
evaluation.target_only_gate: Apply sparse gate on sampled reference; disclose min1000 count failures. Full-GT measured fraction reported separately. Not a method GO.
evaluation.RGB: Only original five saved views for new maps; no new dense surface or TSDF claims in this sensitivity

interpretation: Full mixed arms are not complete GT maps. Sparse source behavior includes visibility/occlusion/covariance-density effects. Target-only changes are measurement sensitivity, not an algorithm. No physical-error contribution percentages or independent-frame significance.
access: Existing office2/HKairport01 only. No new inference, training, calibration repair, office3/office4 prediction or external contact.
